newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says two rebel Kurds killed in clash.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says two rebel Kurds killed in clash.

text.p: Turkey said on Tuesday it had killed two rebel Kurds in a clash in the rugged southeast of the country, according to the state-run Anatolian news agency.
Turkish security forces killed the two Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) guerrillas in the Agri district late on Monday night, it said. There was no mention of any Turkish casualties.
The clash on Turkish soil took place while more than 10,000 Turkish troops are engaged in a cross-border operation to destroy PKK strongholds in the mountains of northern Iraq.
More than 23,000 people have died in 13 years of conflict between the Turkish security forces and the PKK, who are fighting for Kurdish autonomy or independence.
